title: Desenvolvedor Front-end Pleno (Next.js + React)
description:
Sobre a THREAD


A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.


Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, projetados para unir estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.


Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores corporativos, entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que conectam tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.


Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um Desenvolvedor Front-end Pleno (Next.js + React) para atuar 100% remoto na squad de sustentação e evolução de produtos digitais para um cliente do setor financeiro e automotivo.


Você fará parte de um time técnico, experiente e orientado à performance, garantindo estabilidade, correções estruturais e evoluções de front-end com qualidade THREAD.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir interfaces usando Next.js e React , com foco em performance, organização e escalabilidade.
  • Estruturar e gerenciar estado global da aplicação com Redux ou Redux Toolkit .
  • Criar componentes reutilizáveis e estilos escaláveis com SASS/SCSS .
  • Trabalhar com rotas, renderização e organização de páginas em aplicações Next.js .
  • Garantir qualidade de código, padrões de desenvolvimento e versionamento consistente.
  • Corrigir bugs, aprimorar telas existentes e implementar melhorias contínuas.
  • Integrar front-end com APIs REST de forma robusta e organizada.
  • Colaborar com backend, UX e produto em demandas de sustentação e evolução.
  • Analisar e resolver problemas com impacto em produção, com visão técnica e responsabilidade.


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • 3+ anos de experiência com React
  • Experiência prática com Next.js
  • Experiência sólida com TypeScript
  • Domínio de Zustand ou Redux Toolkit
  • SASS/SCSS avançado
  • Integração sólida com APIs REST
  • Git
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com legados modernos e organizar código existente
  • Boa leitura técnica e autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)


  • Conhecimento em SSR, SSG e boas práticas de performance no Next.js
  • Testes com Jest, React Testing Library ou Cypress
  • Storybook
  • Conhecimento de design systems
  • Experiência com aplicações responsivas e foco em usabilidade
  • Noções de SEO técnico em aplicações front-end


Mindset esperado


  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação
  • Comprometimento absoluto com as entregas de backlog
  • Responsabilidade real em cumprir o combinado na planning
  • Organização e disciplina para manter previsibilidade
  • Autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão
  • Capacidade de leitura de contexto e diagnóstico rápido
  • Postura colaborativa, madura e orientada a impacto
  • Foco em simplicidade, qualidade e execução consistente

title: Assistente administrativo
description:

· Somos empáticos pois antes de qualquer coisa, nos colocamos no lugar das pessoas com compaixão e honestidade;

· Buscamos a todo instante ver as coisas de uma forma diferente, nos tornando criativos, curiosos e experimentando sem medo. Acreditamos que as falhas existem e são elas que nos levam ao sucesso mais cedo;

· Prezamos por um ambiente de descontração, rimos alto e geramos a alegria em nosso ambiente de trabalho. Cultivar um ambiente saudável, alegre e de bem estar é a chave para um serviço de excelência!

  • Preparar relatórios, análises semanais e apresentações gerenciais, contribuindo com insights e dados para a tomada de decisão.
  • Apoiar projetos e demandas administrativas dos líderes do departamento, conforme necessidade.

  • Boa organização e atenção aos detalhes

title: Gerente de Testes
description:
Esta posição é responsável pela supervisão de testes de ponta a ponta, incluindo execução da estratégia, gerenciamento de recursos, coordenação com as partes interessadas, gerenciamento de riscos e relatórios de progresso.

O Gerente de Testes planeja, controla e aprimora continuamente as atividades de teste para garantir que o software e os sistemas integrados atendam aos padrões de qualidade definidos antes do lançamento. Isso inclui definir objetivos de qualidade, apoiar a automação de testes quando apropriado e garantir que as equipes compreendam claramente os processos de teste, controles e expectativas de governança.

Responsável por impulsionar práticas de teste consistentes e de alta qualidade em múltiplos projetos. A função garante um modelo de governança unificado, metodologias alinhadas e resultados de entrega previsíveis.



Principais Responsabilidades


• Definir, comunicar e garantir o cumprimento da estratégia geral de testes junto a todas as partes interessadas e equipes de entrega.

• Identificar, garantir e coordenar os recursos de teste alinhados ao escopo e aos marcos de entrega.

• Garantir que os ambientes de teste, os dados e as integrações de sistema estejam disponíveis e adequados à finalidade.

• Analisar e gerenciar defeitos, riscos e problemas decorrentes de todas as fases de teste.

Estabelecer e manter um repositório centralizado de cenários e ativos de teste.

• Identificar e reutilizar materiais de teste existentes para melhorar a eficiência e a consistência.

• Definir e finalizar o escopo de testes em conjunto com todas as áreas impactadas.

• Definir, preparar e validar os requisitos de dados de teste de acordo com o escopo acordado.

• Desenvolver planos detalhados de execução de testes diários, incluindo cenários de contingência e de menor prioridade.

• Definir e obter consenso sobre critérios claros de conclusão dos ciclos de teste.

• Identificar e gerenciar o escopo de testes de regressão para proteger a funcionalidade existente.


Requisitos

Profissional Senior, com experiência comprovada liderando iniciativas complexas de testes em sistemas de grande escala.

• Ampla experiência prática em testes de software e garantia de qualidade em ambientes corporativos.

• Capacidade comprovada de liderar, coordenar e motivar equipes de teste em múltiplos fluxos de trabalho.

• Sólida experiência em planejamento, escopo, estimativa e análise de testes.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com stakeholders em equipes de negócios e técnicas.

• Mentalidade analítica com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.

• Experiência comprovada na definição, implementação e gestão de estratégias e planos de teste.

• Sólido conhecimento de modelos SDLC e uma ampla gama de metodologias de teste.

• Conhecimento prático de ferramentas, frameworks e melhores práticas de automação de testes.


Experiência Desejáveis

• Familiaridade com as plataformas SAP S/4HANA e Salesforce Lightning, incluindo módulos, aplicações e abordagens de entrega.

• Formação técnica com compreensão de integrações de sistemas e protocolos de interface.

• Experiência em planejamento e execução de testes de desempenho, carga e estresse.

• Forte experiência com modelos de entrega ágil e colaboração em equipes multifuncionais.

• Capacidade de análise de negócios, incluindo técnicas de levantamento e validação de requisitos.

• Experiência comprovada em TDD (Desenvolvimento Orientado a Testes).

• Experiência comprovada com Jira XRay, Selenium e Tricentis TTA

title: Business Development Representative
description:
WeMaster Trade is a rapidly scaling fintech company operating in the trading space, connecting traders, partners, and affiliates across global markets. We move fast, think big, and focus on results. • Maintain accurate records of partnerships, communications, and pipeline activity in CRM systems.

• Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support expansion strategies.

• 1–3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or account management roles.

• Strong communication skills in English (professional level).

• Strategic mindset with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

• Experience using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).

• Analytical thinking with a focus on long-term growth and value creation.

• Exposure to global markets and partnership ecosystems

Salary : $800 USD/month + Commission

(IT Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, IT BA, Technical BA)


Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. They have been a market leader within the fintech consultancy sector for many years and their worldwide client base has never been stronger, with significant growth in the last 12 months. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be building collaborative partnerships with key customer stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English. The use of AI to expedite tasks is also expected.


We are keen to hear from talented IT Business Analyst candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.


Location: Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English

title: People Ops Técnico / RH Estratégico – Web3
description:
Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional de People Ops com forte entendimento técnico para atuar na construção, manutenção e evolução de uma equipe de alta performance em um ambiente Web3.

Essa função vai muito além de um RH tradicional.

O foco é garantir que o time esteja composto por profissionais realmente qualificados, com entregas consistentes e alinhados com o nível exigido do projeto.

A pessoa será responsável por contratar corretamente, acompanhar o desempenho diário da equipe e manter um padrão alto de qualidade , com autonomia para atuar de forma direta quando necessário.

Objetivo da função

Garantir que a equipe esteja sempre performando em alto nível, sem necessidade de supervisão constante por parte da liderança, mantendo consistência, qualidade e evolução contínua.

ResponsabilidadesRecrutamento e Seleção
  • Conduzir processos seletivos para perfis técnicos (frontend, backend, Web3, produto)
  • Avaliar candidatos com base em capacidade prática e conhecimento real
  • Validar se o candidato entende o que está fazendo (evitar perfis apenas teóricos)
  • Garantir que as contratações estejam alinhadas com o nível esperado do projeto
  • Participar da definição de perfis ideais para cada vaga
Avaliação Técnica (nível obrigatório)
  • Entender conceitos básicos de desenvolvimento:
  • Frontend (interfaces, UX, comportamento)
  • Backend (lógica, APIs, integração)
  • Fluxo de sistemas (como tudo se conecta)
  • Conseguir conversar com desenvolvedores de forma técnica
  • Identificar inconsistências em respostas técnicas de candidatos
  • Diferenciar profissionais experientes de iniciantes ou superficiais
Acompanhamento de Performance
  • Acompanhar o desempenho diário dos membros da equipe
  • Monitorar consistência de entregas e cumprimento de responsabilidades
  • Identificar rapidamente:
  • Queda de performance
  • Falta de entrega
  • Problemas de alinhamento
  • Garantir que cada membro do time esteja contribuindo de forma real
Organização e Estrutura de Equipe
  • Auxiliar na criação e acompanhamento de metas mensais
  • Garantir clareza de funções dentro da equipe
  • Organizar rotinas de acompanhamento (check-ins, validações, entregas)
  • Identificar gargalos na operação e propor melhorias
  • Ajustar processos internos para aumentar produtividade
Gestão de Qualidade da Equipe
  • Manter um padrão alto de qualidade e performance
  • Não permitir permanência de profissionais com desempenho inconsistente
  • Atuar com autonomia na tomada de decisões relacionadas à equipe
  • Garantir que o time evolua constantemente
Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Experiência com recrutamento, RH ou gestão de pessoas
  • Entendimento técnico de desenvolvimento (não precisa programar, mas precisa entender)
  • Conhecimento básico de:
  • Frontend / Backend
  • APIs e integração de sistemas
  • Conhecimento em Web3 (wallets, exchanges, blockchain, transações)
  • Capacidade real de avaliar profissionais técnicos
  • Organização e capacidade analítica
  • Boa comunicação e postura firme
Importante (leia com atenção)

Esta vaga não é para RH tradicional .

Você precisa:

  • Entender como produtos digitais funcionam
  • Conseguir avaliar se um desenvolvedor realmente sabe o que está fazendo
  • Conseguir acompanhar a performance da equipe com base em entregas reais
  • Ter autonomia para tomar decisões sem depender de validação constante

Você não precisa programar , mas precisa entender o suficiente para não ser dependente de terceiros na avaliação técnica.

Perfil esperado
  • Alto nível de responsabilidade
  • Foco em performance e resultado
  • Não aceita entregas superficiais ou inconsistentes
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões difíceis quando necessário
  • Comprometimento real com o projeto
  • Proatividade e autonomia no dia a dia
  • Perfil direto, organizado e orientado à execução
Diferenciais

title: Data Engineer GCP |  Snowflake
description:
Job Title: Senior Data Engineer (GCP BigQuery & Snowflake)

Location: Remote



Job Summary


We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Data Engineer to design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines across cloud platforms. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in GCP (BigQuery), Snowflake, and Python , along with a solid foundation in data warehousing concepts and modern DevOps practices.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support and maintain existing Snowflake workflows and data pipelines
  • Operate, monitor, and stabilize migrated BigQuery workflows
  • Integrate international business logic into global data pipelines to ensure scalability and standardization
  • Design, build, and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines across hybrid environments (AWS, GCP, Snowflake )
  • Implement data quality checks, validation logic, and reconciliation processes
  • Optimize pipeline performance, compute usage, storage, and query costs (especially in BigQuery)
  • Develop and maintain documentation for all data pipelines and workflows
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support data-driven decision making
  • Follow and contribute to modern DevOps practices , including CI/CD and version control


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related discipline
  • 12–15 years of overall IT experience
  • 7–9 years of hands-on data engineering experience


Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with:
  • GCP BigQuery
  • Snowflake
  • Python & SQL
  • Apache Airflow / Cloud Composer

title: Senior Web Manager
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team.

You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals.
  • Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience.
  • Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators.
  • Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads.
  • Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.


What We’re Looking For:

  • Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.
  • Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful.
  • Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components.
  • SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager.
  • Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution.
  • Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.


Why Join Us:

This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
OPEN TO ALL CANDIDATES ACROSS LATIN AMERICA


Title:  Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) – Data Infrastructure & Recommendations

Company:  Fulcrum SaaS

Location: Remote – Latin America (strong overlap with Americas time zones required)

Type:  Full-time

Level:  Senior / Staff

Compensation:  USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location


About Fulcrum SaaS

Fulcrum SaaS is a conversion rate optimization (CRO) platform that powers product recommendations for ecommerce brands. Our infrastructure processes high-volume behavioral events, feeds real-time recommendation algorithms, and serves personalized experiences at scale. We operate in a multi-tenant SaaS environment where data correctness, low latency, and system reliability are non-negotiable.

Our stack includes Go, Bigtable, BigQuery, Pub/Sub, and a dual-store architecture (operational + analytical) that we designed from scratch.


The Role

We are looking for a senior backend engineer who has built and operated production data systems under real load—not prototypes, not internal tools. This is a core infrastructure role at the intersection of our operational and analytical data layers.

You will own the systems that move behavioral event data from ingestion through transformation into our recommendation engine. You will design for correctness, build for observability, and make architectural tradeoffs with the pragmatism that only comes from production scars.

You will be an early engineering hire with real influence over our technical direction.


What You’ll Do

  • Design and operate high-throughput event ingestion pipelines capable of processing millions of events per day with low-latency serving requirements.
  • Own the dual-store architecture that separates our operational (real-time) and analytical (batch) data layers, including streaming vs. batch pipeline design and failure recovery.
  • Build and maintain data movement infrastructure between stores (Bigtable/BigQuery or comparable), ensuring consistency, at-least-once delivery, and graceful degradation.
  • Instrument production systems: define SLOs, implement distributed tracing, and build alerting that distinguishes signal from noise.
  • Partner with the recommendation team to evolve our scoring, waterfall, and ranking infrastructure.
  • Drive architectural decisions on data modeling, schema evolution, and multi-tenant isolation.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and own incidents end-to-end—from detection through root cause analysis to postmortem.


What We’re Looking For (Must-Haves)

  • 5–10+ years of hands-on backend engineering in production environments (more is better).
  • Track record of building and operating high-performance, high-throughput, low-latency systems at scale—not just prototypes.
  • Deep working knowledge of Go’s concurrency model (goroutines, channels, context, sync primitives)—beyond syntax familiarity.
  • Experience with columnar or wide-column stores: Bigtable/BigQuery strongly preferred; Cassandra, DynamoDB, Redshift, or Snowflake are comparable.
  • Hands-on experience moving data between operational and analytical stores—you have solved streaming vs. batch tradeoffs, handled delivery guarantees, and recovered from pipeline failures.
  • Experience with production observability: metrics, tracing, alerting, dashboards—you know what good instrumentation looks like.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS experience—you understand isolation, scaling, and noisy-neighbor challenges when serving multiple customers on shared infrastructure.
  • Batch pipeline design experience—you know when batch is the right tool and how to make it reliable.
  • Dual-store architecture experience—you have operated systems where the operational and analytical data layers are intentionally separate.
  • Comfortable working daily in English with a US-based team (meetings, async communication, code reviews, and technical documentation).


Strong Nice-to-Haves

  • Identity resolution and cross-device stitching (probabilistic or deterministic).
  • A/B testing infrastructure built for statistical rigor—not just feature flags, but impression tracking, experiment analysis, and statistical significance frameworks.
  • Recommendation systems experience: scoring heuristics, waterfall algorithms, collaborative filtering, or hybrid approaches.
  • Ecommerce domain knowledge: attribution models, conversion tracking, order/cart data models, session stitching.


What We Offer

  • Compensation in the range of USD 70,000–100,000 per year, depending on experience and location, benchmarked to senior remote engineering roles in LATAM.
  • Remote-first culture with async-friendly practices.
  • Direct access to leadership; your architectural opinions will be heard and implemented.
  • A team that treats production reliability as a first-class engineering concern.


How to Apply

Please apply through LinkedIn with your CV (English) and a brief note highlighting:

  • Your experience with Go in production.
  • The most demanding data/throughput system you have owned.
  • Your country of residence and preferred start date.

You can also include links to GitHub, technical blogs, or talks if available.

With expertise in Data & AI, Cloud migrations, IT consulting, and enterprise application optimisation, MillionLogics offers tailored services with a focus on client success. Supported by a team of over 50 AI & Oracle experts, MillionLogics combines cutting-edge technology with a commitment to delivering impactful outcomes. Learn more about our services on our website.


Role Overview:

As an AI Quality Analyst, you will evaluate a new personalisation feature for Gemini. You will assess how well the model uses information from your past Gemini conversations, Gmail, Google Search, and YouTube activity to make responses more relevant and helpful. This role requires a unique blend of creativity and analytical rigour. You will actively design prompts from the perspective of your own personal experiences. You will then use your analytical skills to assess the quality of the model's personalised responses, evaluating dimensions like Grounding, Integration, and Helpfulness.


Offer Details:


Pay: US$ 1500 per month (Net/take-home)

Contract Duration: 12 months

Number of Open Positions: 20


Key Qualifications

  • Portuguese Proficiency: Ability to read and write in Portuguese with a high degree of comp, as Portuguese is the focus language for this project.
  • Schedule Flexibility: Full-time availability in your local time zone is required. We are staffing a global, 24-hour operations team.
  • Exceptional Analytical Thinking: Demonstrate ability to evaluate nuanced and ambiguous AI responses, specifically assessing personalisation quality.
  • Creative Prompt Engineering: Experience in designing creative, multi-turn starting prompts based on personal context to thoroughly test the model's capabilities.
  • Strong Evaluation Acumen: Understanding of personalisation concepts, including the ability to identify incorrect personalisation, poor inferences, and forced connections.
  • Meticulous Attention to Detail: The ability to review Side-by-Side (SxS) model responses and spot subtle differences in naturalness and overnarrating.
  • Excellent Written Communication: Superior ability to write clear, concise, and structured rationales for model rankings, explicitly referencing specific turn numbers.
  • Feedback: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Description:

  • In this role, you will be part of a dynamic team focused on evaluating the quality of personalised AI interactions. Your day-to-day work will involve:
  • Designing and executing multi-turn conversational prompts (typically 1-5 turns) that require the AI to utilise your personal information and experiences.
  • Evaluating model responses based on your intent from the starting prompt, checking if the personalisation was appropriately applied.
  • Analysing responses for Grounding issues, ensuring claims about you are supported by evidence and not flawed inferences or hallucinations.
  • Assessing Integration quality to ensure personal data is woven naturally into the response without robotic \"overnarrating\".
  • Rigorously evaluating and stack-ranking two model responses side-by-side (SxS) to determine which is overall more helpful, easy to use, and enjoyable.
  • Writing clear, defensible rationales for your comparisons, explicitly referencing where issues or positive aspects occurred in the conversation.
  • Extracting and verifying \"Debug Info\" from the model to confirm that chat summaries and data sources were properly utilised.
  • Maintaining strict data hygiene by deleting evaluation conversations to prevent them from polluting your future chat history.


Education & Experience

  • BS/BA degree or equivalent experience in a relevant field (e.g., Policy, Law, Ethics, Linguistics, Journalism, Computer Science, or a related analytical field).
  • Experience in data annotation, AI quality evaluation, content moderation, or a related role is strongly preferred.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and a minimum of 30 hours per week, with 4 hours of overlap with PST. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process -

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements.


How to Apply?

Please send us your updated CV to with job ID: 62131 as your email subject.

title: Cloud AI/ML Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a \"cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models; you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP) , Azure AI , or AWS SageMaker , specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.


Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build \"the bridge\" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Remote Appointment Setter
description:
B2B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call)


Connect With Us:


  • LinkedIn:
  • Twitter/X:
  • Company: gpsocials.com 


This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


Apply Here (See Instructions Below)


(


The Opportunity: Why GP Socials


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role


You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Senior Estimator
description:
Company Overview:

Our ingenuity fuels daily life. Together, we’ve forged some of the most trusted partnerships across the energy value chain to make what was once just an idea a reality: laying subsea infrastructure thousands of feet below sea level, installing platforms hundreds of miles from shore, using our expertise to design and build offshore wind infrastructure, and reshaping the onshore landscape to deliver the energy products the world needs safely and sustainably.


For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. Today, we're driving the energy transition with more than 30,000 of the brightest minds across 54 countries.


Job Overview:

The Senior Estimator uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the estimating discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the estimating discipline. The Senior Estimator solves complex problems and uses their discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Estimator impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the estimating team and other related teams and ensures that they are working within the appropriate guidelines and policies.


Job Responsibility:

  • Review, query, and understand the scope of work in order to prepare a proper estimate and direct attention to those areas that appear inconsistent or contain a high-risk element .
  • Support the PMT team to generate the Marine/Offshore Estimate for the Preliminary stage to ensure Bid No Bid.
  • Review the Project Plan along with the project planner and prepare subcontract scope packages for any work that is required to be subcontracted.
  • Gather information and input from functions with support from the Project Manager.
  • Consult with Subject Matter Expert (SME) to discuss Estimates and resolve issues.
  • Generate estimates with available Benchmark data and from experience prior to receiving the inputs from functions and evaluate the estimates received from functions against the internal estimate
  • Liaise with Project Team members plus all functional departments based on the specific functions allotted for a project, subcontractors and vendors, and Customer; including Procurement, Fabrication, Marine, Quality, HSES, Completions, and Welding Technology
  • Provide input to the Project Estimators, along with Basis of Estimate and Bench Markers
  • Give regular updates to the department manager/PMT /immediate supervisor and highlight any concerns about anything that might potentially jeopardize submitting a competitive proposal.
  • Analyze the cost components that are critical/crucial and seek quotes for applicable items.
  • Participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, as well as any additional bid-related meetings, as required.
  • Prepare a comprehensive Basis of Estimate (BOE).
  • Review and identify contract price form.
  • Understand and clarify unit rate and lump sum breakdowns.
  • Accurately manage all the Previous Tender information and Treat it with Confidentiality
  • Utilize support from the benchmarking team (SMEs) by analyzing information on the costs from other similar projects and preparing the relevant benchmark report.
  • Attend and participate in Bid review meetings, estimate evaluation meetings, Risk assessment meetings, etc., as necessary for the Project/Department/Tender
  • Participate in HAZAN, HAZID, HAZOP, and other safety /operability/ reliability studies and workshops, as necessary for Project/Tender
  • Ensure any Risk or Opportunity highlighted is Duly captured for the Management review and approval.
  • Post Tender submission provide input for the clarification.
  • Support bid handover process ensuring proper transfer of pricing basis and critical assumptions to project team.
  • Manage own time to meet objectives; forecast and plan resource requirements.
  • Incorporate project planner input to develop the cost.
  • Assure that the estimate is:
  • Completed promptly
  • Cognizant of the Bid ‘Win Strategy’
  • Aligned with planned schedeule
  • All the Risk and Opportunities highlighted.
  • With Due Basis of Estimate
  • Accurate, free of errors, omission, or hidden contingency
  • In line with the agreed execution plan
  • Evaluate and recommend ways to be more cost-effective or profitable


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering or related technical discipline preferred. Equivalent experience will be considered.
  • Five plus (5+) years of experience in a large Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) company (preferably in Offshore/Marine Operations, and offshore estimation, ).
  • Subsea/SURF experience with Minimum 3–5 years of direct experience in subsea/SURF construction estimation, including deepwater pipeline installation, flexible/umbilical lay, subsea structure installation, and marine spread costs.
  • Experience with DSV, PLSV, and/or Heavy Construction Vessel (HCV) spread rate estimation strongly preferred.
  • Cost estimation experience, preferably in the Oil & Gas industry
  • Willingness to work overtime as necessary to meet deadlines
  • Intermediate level in Microsoft Office systems, e.g., Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, Project
  • Accurately evaluate detailed specifications that are crucial to a cost estimator’s success
  • Must pay attention to minute details because such details may impact a product’s overall cost

Must plan their work and work efficiently and accurately.

This role combines leadership, coaching supervision, quality control, and operational oversight. You will ensure livestreams meet both technical and content standards while helping coaches support Explorers effectively.


Livestreaming runs around the clock, so this role requires strong ownership, resilience, and initiative. You should be comfortable maintaining quality standards through team coordination, structured supervision, and proactive monitoring even outside standard working hours when needed.

  • Proven experience in livestreaming, video content, media production, or coaching

  • Strong work ethic and ability to operate in a fast-moving environment

Nice to Have

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

title: Cloud Security Engineer Sênior
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Cloud Security Engineer para integrar nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será referência técnica em segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on na proteção de ambientes digitais complexos — com foco em pipelines seguros, desenvolvimento seguro e ambientes multicloud.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Projetar e revisar arquiteturas seguras para aplicações web, APIs e sites, identificando vulnerabilidades e propondo melhorias estruturais.
  • Configurar, evoluir e automatizar pipelines CI/CD no GitLab com integração de ferramentas de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning), garantindo que segurança faça parte do fluxo de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (Secure SDLC), conduzindo análises de código e orientações sobre boas práticas de segurança.
  • Criar automações para monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes, reduzindo a superfície de ataque de forma contínua.
  • Atuar na segurança de infraestruturas multicloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP), incluindo IAM, gestão de segredos, redes e conformidade com políticas de segurança.
  • Colaborar com squads e stakeholders técnicos para disseminar cultura de segurança, participar de revisões de arquitetura e contribuir proativamente com soluções inovadoras.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre o cenário de ameaças, CVEs relevantes e novas tecnologias de segurança, trazendo insights para o time.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência com threat modeling, revisão de arquitetura de apps e sites, e conhecimento de OWASP Top 10 e boas práticas de segurança em APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Domínio avançado de GitLab CI/CD, com experiência em configurar stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection) e integrar ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de práticas como code review com foco em segurança, análise de dependências vulneráveis, gestão de segredos e políticas de controle de acesso.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver scripts, playbooks e automações (Python, Bash ou similares) para triagem de alertas, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes.
  • Experiência em ao menos um provedor (AWS, Azure ou GCP) com foco em IAM, segurança de redes, gestão de segredos (Vault, KMS) e conformidade (CIS Benchmarks, CSPM).
  • Familiaridade com OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Prowler ou equivalentes.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Conhecimento de frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001 ou SOC 2.

title: Senior Bookkeeper - Analista Financeiro Sênior
description:
Downtown Engineers 

Senior Bookkeeper / Analista Financeiro Sênior

(full-time, remote)

About Downtown Engineers

Downtown Engineers (DWT ENG) is a New York-based MEP (Mechanical, Electrical & Plumbing) engineering firm trusted by architecture offices, developers and national brands. Our team has completed over 300 projects and designed more than 3 million square feet of built space across sectors like hospitality, retail, franchises, healthcare and more.


About the Opportunity

Downtown is looking for a Senior Bookkeeper to take full ownership of our day-to-day financial operations. As a fast-growing firm with multiple simultaneous projects and an extensive client base, we need a senior professional who brings organization, predictability and continuous process improvement to our financial routine.


This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role. We're looking for someone highly process-oriented and analytically sharp, someone who sees beyond the numbers and proactively identifies gaps, anticipates problems and builds scalable financial systems. 


You'll work directly with leadership, turning financial data into clear insights that support strategic decisions.


Compensation & Structure

  • Full-time contractor (remote)
  • Fixed monthly compensation: R$8.000 - R$10.000
  • Schedule aligned with New York time zone (EST)


What you’ll do


1.Financial operations & accounts receivable

  • Manage the company's full financial routine end-to-end
  • Lead Accounts Receivable control, including invoice issuance, tracking and collections
  • Actively manage aging reports and conduct structured follow-ups with clients
  • Oversee correct categorization of all expenses
  • Conduct phone-based collections with U.S. clients, maintaining a professional and firm communication style


2.Reporting & financial intelligence

  • Perform bank and credit card reconciliations with high accuracy
  • Prepare and analyze financial reports, including P&L, expense reports, cash flow and forecasts
  • Ensure consistency and reliability of all financial data
  • Deliver financial insights directly to leadership to support strategic decisions


3.Process improvement & systems

  • Develop, standardize and optimize internal financial processes
  • Implement billing systems and automated reminders
  • Identify operational bottlenecks and propose continuous improvements


Requirements


Must-haves

  • Solid experience (minimum 5 years) as a Bookkeeper or in a similar financial role
  • Proven experience managing full financial cycles (AR, expenses, reconciliations)
  • Proficiency in accounting software (Zoho Books, QuickBooks, Xero or similar)
  • 6+ years of experience with financial reporting (P&L, aging, cash flow)
  • Fluent English (written and spoken), this role includes direct phone collections with U.S.-based clients
  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets
  • Strong analytical skills and extreme attention to detail
  • Ability to manage high transaction volumes and multiple clients simultaneously


Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with financial system automations and integrations
  • Background in professional services firms (engineering, architecture, consulting, etc.)
  • Experience with U.S.-based financial operations
  • Track record of structuring or scaling financial processes


Who we're looking for

  • Senior profile with a true ownership mindset over the financial area
  • Extremely organized and process-driven
  • Proactive, with the ability to anticipate problems before they escalate
  • Professional communicator, especially when handling collections
  • Comfortable working independently and making decisions
  • Focused on efficiency, standardization and continuous improvement


Selection Process

  • Apply to the opportunity, submitting the form with your CV and English experience
  • Screening: English and communication assessment (video)
  • Technical challenge
  • Interview with leadership
  • Offer


Why join Downtown?

  • Role with direct business impact
  • Work with top architects and U.S. brands
  • Fast-moving, low-bureaucracy culture with real autonomy
  • High growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

description:
Estamos construindo um novo braço de Inteligência Artificial em forte crescimento e buscamos uma pessoa de Customer Success para garantir que nossos clientes realmente extraiam valor do produto no dia a dia.

Essa posição é focada em experiência, adoção e comportamento de uso. Não envolve implementação ou desenvolvimento técnico.

Estamos falando de um produto que muda a forma como empresas operam, automatizam e tomam decisão. Nesse contexto, sucesso do cliente não é suporte. É impacto.

Essa pessoa vai acompanhar o uso real da ferramenta, entender comportamentos, identificar onde o cliente trava e atuar para destravar.

Vai ser ponte entre cliente e produto.

Vai transformar dúvida em clareza.

Vai transformar fricção em evolução.


Descrição da vaga

Buscamos um(a) profissional de Customer Success com perfil analítico e consultivo, que entenda que sucesso do cliente está diretamente ligado à adoção, engajamento e geração de valor.

Essa pessoa será responsável por acompanhar a jornada dos clientes, apoiar dúvidas técnicas e funcionais e identificar oportunidades de melhoria na experiência.

É uma posição estratégica, com impacto direto em retenção, satisfação e evolução do produto.


O papel, na prática

  • Acompanhar como os clientes utilizam a plataforma no dia a dia
  • Apoiar dúvidas técnicas e funcionais com clareza e proximidade
  • Identificar padrões de uso, fricções e oportunidades de melhoria
  • Atuar para aumentar adoção, engajamento e retenção
  • Levar feedbacks estruturados para produto e influenciar evolução


O que buscamos?

  • Alguém que entenda Customer Success como geração de resultado, não apenas suporte
  • Boa leitura de comportamento de usuário, identificando sinais de baixa evolução no uso
  • Conforto em navegar em produtos mais robustos, que exigem interpretação
  • Comunicação clara, capaz de traduzir tecnologia em algo simples e aplicável
  • Proatividade real, antecipando problemas e oportunidades
  • Interesse genuíno por tecnologia e inteligência artificial aplicada a negócios


O que faz esse perfil se destacar?

  • Experiência com SaaS que exige adoção e mudança de comportamento
  • Vivência com produtos de automação, dados ou IA
  • Capacidade de conectar uso da ferramenta com impacto no negócio do cliente
  • Conhecimento em Vibe Coding será um diferencial
  • Inglês avançado será um diferencial

title: Analista / Consultor(a) Oracle EBS Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS
description:
Analista / Consultor Oracle Financials (FA) — PIS/COFINS

Especialista em ERP Financeiro com foco em apuração e adequação às novas regras de PIS/COFINS

Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos um profissional com sólida experiência em Oracle Financials (FA) para atuar em um projeto estratégico de análise e adequação do sistema ERP às novas regras de PIS/COFINS. O ambiente é de sistema não nativo, com alto volume de customizações, exigindo capacidade analítica para entender o estado atual da solução, identificar gaps e propor as adaptações necessárias para conformidade fiscal.


Principais responsabilidades

Analisar o funcionamento atual do sistema ERP Oracle FA no que tange ao processo de apuração de PIS/COFINS, mapeando fluxos, regras de negócio e customizações existentes.

Identificar gaps entre a situação atual do sistema e os requisitos exigidos pela nova legislação de PIS/COFINS, propondo soluções de adequação.

Trabalhar com regime misto de apuração (cumulativo e não cumulativo), com foco especial na tomada de crédito pelas entradas.

Especificar e acompanhar as customizações e adaptações sistêmicas necessárias para atender às novas obrigações fiscais, em parceria com equipes técnicas e de desenvolvimento.

Documentar processos de negócio e requisitos funcionais (AS IS / TO BE), garantindo rastreabilidade das decisões e aderência à legislação vigente.

Apoiar testes, homologação e validação das entregas sistêmicas, assegurando conformidade tributária e integridade dos dados fiscais.


Diferenciais desejáveis

Experiência anterior em projetos de adequação fiscal e reforma tributária em sistemas ERP.

Conhecimento em SPED Contribuições (EFD-Contribuições) e obrigações acessórias relacionadas.

Noções de SQL para análise e validação de dados em ambiente Oracle.

Graduação em Ciências Contábeis, Administração, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

title: Brazil - Business Development Manager (Medical Devices)
description:
About Taevas

Taevas Life Sciences is a medical technology company delivering advanced diagnostic devices across areas such as audiology, balance & vestibular care, sleep therapy, and imaging.


We focus on providing high-quality, clinician-designed solutions that improve diagnostic accuracy, streamline workflows, and enhance patient care across diverse healthcare settings. With a strong emphasis on innovation, accessibility, and practical application, we support healthcare providers across India and global markets.


Website:


Job Title: Business Development Manager – Medical Devices

Location: Brazil

Employment Type: Full-Time


Role Overview

We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Business Development Manager to lead medical device sales and commercialisation efforts in Colombia. The ideal candidate will bring strong market knowledge, an established network within the healthcare ecosystem, and the ability to drive both product and service revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities

Primary Responsibilities: Medical Device Sales & Commercialisation Strategy

Sales Strategy & Implementation

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive commercialisation strategy for assigned medical devices in the Colombian market
  • Identify target markets, customer segments, and strategic partnerships across hospitals, clinics, and distribution networks
  • Conduct product demonstrations and training sessions for healthcare professionals, including physicians, hospital staff, and distributors


Market Expansion

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with hospitals, clinics, rehabilitation/therapy centers, and distributors
  • Drive market penetration through key opinion leader (KOL) engagement and evidence-based product positioning
  • Perform competitor analysis and market research to identify new growth opportunities


Sales Targets & Performance

  • Achieve defined quarterly and annual sales targets
  • Track and report KPIs including sales performance, pipeline status, customer feedback, and competitive insights


Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with regulatory, marketing, and operations teams to ensure compliance with Colombian regulatory requirements, including INVIMA guidelines
  • Support post-sales activities to ensure high customer satisfaction and long-term retention


Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, or a related field
  • Pharmacist license preferred

Technical Skills

  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in medical device sales, commercialisation, and business development
  • Strong understanding of Colombia’s healthcare system and medical device regulatory landscape (INVIMA knowledge preferred)
  • Proven experience in building and managing distributor networks and institutional relationships

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and consistently achieve sales targets


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work with a growing medical device organization
  • Exposure to innovative healthcare technologies
  • Collaborative and performance-driven work environment
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunities


Why Join Taevas Medical Devices

  • Be part of expanding medical device commercialization in Colombia
  • Work closely with healthcare leaders and key stakeholders
  • Drive meaningful impact in improving patient care through advanced medical technologies

title: Técnica de enfermagem

No Grupo Nilo Frantz , lidamos com o bem mais precioso das pessoas: o sonho de gerar uma vida. Somos referência em excelência técnica, mas o nosso maior diferencial é o cuidado humano. Acreditamos que a tecnologia mais avançada precisa vir acompanhada do olhar mais acolhedor.

  • Receber e acompanhar os exames enviados pelos pacientes.


O que buscamos em você:

Formação completa em Técnico de Enfermagem com COREN ativo e regular.

Organização, atenção aos detalhes e proatividade para lidar com as rotinas do bloco cirúrgico e salas de apoio.


Skills: Empatia, escuta ativa e postura acolhedora. O nosso ambiente exige delicadeza e sensibilidade no trato com os pacientes.

title: Data Entry Specialist (Growth Opportunity)
description:
Company Description


Best Servicers of America is an innovative provider of on-site service solutions, dedicated to enhancing brand image and customer service experience. We provide accurate diagnostic support, technical assistance, and follow-up communication to ensure customer satisfaction. Our team works closely with businesses to deliver tailored solutions, dispatching professional technicians to support their operations.

Role Description

We are currently seeking a detail-oriented and reliable Data Entry Specialist to support our team, primarily handling post-service survey processes and administrative tasks.

In this role, the agent will be responsible for contacting customers after service repairs are completed to confirm that the repair was successful and that the unit is functioning properly. The position involves conducting follow-up calls in English, documenting customer feedback, and ensuring all survey data is accurately recorded.

Additionally, the agent will identify any complaints, concerns, or unresolved issues reported by customers and escalate them appropriately for further action. Clear communication, attention to detail, and the ability to capture accurate information are essential, as this role plays a key part in maintaining service quality and customer satisfaction.

This role is designed as an entry point into the company. Based on performance, candidates may be considered for advancement into a Customer Service Agent position or other departments.

Starting Salary: $700 USD/month

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately input and manage survey data
  • Review and verify information for accuracy and completeness
  • Maintain organized records and follow internal processes
  • Communicate effectively with team members and supervisors
  • Support additional administrative tasks as needed

Requirements

  • High level of English proficiency (written and spoken) – mandatory
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines
  • Basic computer skills and familiarity with data systems
  • Proactive mindset and willingness to learn

Growth Opportunity

High-performing candidates will have the opportunity to grow within the company and be considered for roles such as Customer Service Agent or other departments, depending on performance and business needs.

Work Conditions

  • Remote position (Work from Home)
  • Schedule: Monday to Friday
  • 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or
  • 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM (EST – USA)

Technical Requirements

  • Computer with a minimum of 8GB RAM
  • High-speed internet (100 Mbps or higher)
  • Headset with microphone (no earbuds or AirPods)
  • Quiet work environment (no background noise)
  • Dual monitors required for training (pictures will be requested before interview)

Hiring Process

  • Applications will be reviewed within 48 hours
  • Selected candidates will receive a DocuSign form via email
  • After completing the form, candidates must contact us via Skype (link provided) to schedule an interview
  • Only candidates who follow all steps will be considered

Important Notes

  • Salary is fixed at $700 USD/month (non-negotiable)
  • Resumes must be submitted in English

We are looking for motivated individuals who want to grow with us and take advantage of future opportunities within the company.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager — Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads
description:
Company: ScalixAI Location: Fully Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: Founder / CEO


About ScalixAI

ScalixAI is a performance-focused Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads agency built on one principle: paid media should drive real business outcomes, not vanity metrics. Founded by a former 8-year Google veteran, we work with ambitious SaaS companies, B2B brands, nonprofits, home services operators, and growth-stage businesses who expect more than dashboards — they expect partnership, strategy, and results.


We're small, sharp, and scaling. This role is central to how we grow.


The Role

We're hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager who lives at the intersection of Google Ads expertise, LinkedIn Ads fluency, and high-trust client relationships. You'll own a book of business end-to-end — from kickoff through renewal — and be the strategic voice clients rely on when they want to know why the numbers are moving and what to do next.

This isn't a reporting role. This is a thinking-partner role. You'll build campaigns that actually ladder up to revenue, translate performance into narrative, and hold the line on strategy when clients push in unproductive directions.


What You'll Own
  • Client relationships. You are the face of ScalixAI for your accounts. You lead weekly/bi-weekly calls, quarterly business reviews, and the hard conversations that come with managing paid media budgets.
  • Campaign strategy and execution. You build, optimize, and scale Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display, YouTube) and LinkedIn Ads (Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, ABM campaigns) across multiple verticals.
  • Storytelling through data. You turn performance data into a narrative the client's CEO, CMO, or founder actually wants to read. Numbers alone don't retain clients — meaning does.
  • Attribution and measurement. You set up clean measurement (GA4, LinkedIn Insight Tag, conversion APIs, offline conversion imports) and defend the integrity of attribution when the data gets messy.
  • Proactive optimization. You don't wait for the client to ask. You spot, flag, and fix.
  • Retention and expansion. You identify opportunities to expand scope and you catch churn signals before they become churn.


What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 5–8 years of hands-on paid media experience, with meaningful time spent in both Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads (not just one with a side of the other)
  • Direct, in-platform experience with Fibbler
  • Proven track record managing client relationships as the primary point of contact — ideally in an agency or consultancy setting
  • Strong storytelling ability: you can write a QBR narrative, present on Zoom with confidence, and explain a CPA spike in a way that builds trust rather than erodes it
  • Deep technical fluency in campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing, and conversion tracking across both platforms
  • Comfort with attribution conversations — last-click vs. data-driven, view-through, offline conversion imports, CRM-integrated measurement
  • B2B and SaaS paid media experience

Bonus:

  • HVAC, home services, or nonprofit vertical experience
  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, HockeyStack, or similar
  • LinkedIn Marketing Labs certification and/or Google Ads certifications
  • Experience building SOPs, onboarding docs, or client-facing collateral


Who Thrives Here
  • You treat client accounts like you own them, because at ScalixAI, you effectively do.
  • You have opinions and you can defend them — but you also know when to flex.
  • You're allergic to fluff. You'd rather say \"here's what's working, here's what isn't, here's what we're changing\" than hide behind a 40-slide deck.
  • You want to work on a team that moves fast, ships work, and treats paid media as a craft — not a commodity.


What We Offer
  • Fully remote — work from anywhere that overlaps reasonably with North American client hours
  • Direct access to the founder and real input on how the agency is built
  • A portfolio of clients who actually want to be partnered with (we screen hard at the front door)
  • Room to grow into team leadership as we scale


How to Apply

Send us:

  • A short note on the most interesting paid media problem you've solved in the last 12 months — across either Google or LinkedIn
  • Your resume or LinkedIn profile
  • One QBR, case study, or client-facing deliverable you're proud of (redact as needed)
  • We read everything. We respond to everyone who takes the time to apply thoughtfully.
