title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Retention Account Manager
description:
About Lilo Social

Lilo Social is a full-funnel eCommerce growth agency specializing in acquisition and retention for direct-to-consumer brands. With a team of over 50 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle—from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing.


Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners.


The Role

As an Retention Account Manager at Lilo Social, you will serve as the primary retention marketing contact for 7-10 client accounts, ensuring seamless execution and delivery of email and SMS programs. You will bridge the gap between strategic vision and tactical execution, coordinating with designers, copywriters, and strategists to deliver high-quality retention campaigns that drive repeat purchases and customer lifetime value. This role requires exceptional organizational skills, deep platform expertise, and the ability to build trusted client relationships through reliable communication and flawless execution.


What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent on-time delivery of retention campaigns and flows with zero quality issues across your client portfolio
  • High client satisfaction scores and retention through proactive communication and strategic support
  • Efficient project coordination that enables your team to meet ambitious deliverable timelines
  • Strong retention performance metrics (revenue per recipient, list growth, engagement rates) driven by execution excellence and strategic QA


Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for retention marketing across 7-10 assigned client accounts, managing all communication via Slack and email
  • Prepare for and participate in client calls (monthly or bi-weekly), providing retention performance updates, execution status reports, and tactical recommendations while supporting senior strategists
  • Translate client retention goals and strategic direction into clear, actionable deliverables for internal teams including designers, copywriters, and developers
  • Manage end-to-end project coordination in Asana, creating tasks, tracking progress, and ensuring on-time delivery without managing team capacity or resource allocation
  • Conduct comprehensive QA on all email campaigns, SMS messages, and lifecycle flows before launch to ensure accuracy, functionality, brand consistency, and technical performance
  • Monitor retention performance metrics using Klaviyo, Hiro, and platform analytics, preparing performance summaries and identifying optimization opportunities
  • Maintain deep expertise in Klaviyo and SMS platforms (Attentive, Postscript), staying current on platform updates, retention best practices, and deliverability standards
  • Troubleshoot technical issues across email flows, campaign deployment, segmentation logic, and deliverability concerns
  • Oversee list growth initiatives, on-site capture optimization, and popup strategy to drive subscriber acquisition
  • Document all client action items, requests, and deliverable changes, converting them into trackable tasks with clear ownership
  • Flag client concerns, technical blockers, or strategic questions early to internal leadership for resolution
  • Support account renewals and expansion opportunities through exceptional execution and client relationship management


Requirements

  • 3-5 years of experience in email marketing, retention marketing, or account management within DTC ecommerce or agency environments
  • Expert-level proficiency in Klaviyo, including campaign management, flow architecture, segmentation, deliverability optimization, and analytics
  • Experience with SMS marketing platforms such as Attentive, Postscript, or similar tools
  • Proven track record managing multiple client accounts simultaneously (ideally 5-10 accounts) with strong organizational capabilities
  • Deep understanding of retention marketing principles including lifecycle flows, campaign strategy, customer segmentation, and LTV optimization
  • Strong project management skills with experience using tools like Asana, ClickUp, Monday, or Notion
  • Excellent client communication abilities with a professional, proactive, and service-oriented approach
  • Technical knowledge of email deliverability, list hygiene, sender reputation, and technical email best practices


Nice to Have

  • Agency experience managing multiple DTC brands with varying retention strategies and needs
  • Experience with Hiro or other email analytics and attribution platforms
  • QA or quality assurance background with systematic testing approaches
  • Strategic thinking abilities to identify upsell opportunities and retention program expansion
  • Familiarity with Shopify and ecommerce platform integrations
  • Experience supporting or managing retention programs generating $100K+ monthly attributed revenue


Compensation and Benefits

  • Fully Remote : Work from anywhere within EST to PST hours with a distributed team culture
  • Generous Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance
  • Compensation: Competitive salary commensurate with experience.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:
About us:

Closir is a UK-based investor relations (IR) support services provider. For over a decade we have been entrusted by blue chip companies around the world to help them achieve their IR objectives due to our intimate knowledge of the global buy-side, our technological expertise, and our close, long-term partnership approach.

The Closir platform is an all-in-one, web-based solution which makes companies much smarter and more effective, by helping them to achieve their IR objectives intelligently and proactively.

Closir combines all elements of IR, from high-level strategy (“Who’s investing in my peers?”) to daily workflow (“What topics came up most in my meetings with investors this quarter?”) into one intelligent, user-friendly platform which includes the most comprehensive and up-to-date database of buy-side contacts on the market; proactive outreach tools; share & peer holder tracking; customisable reports; and professional-level support.


Role Overview:

We are looking for a customer-centric, self-driven individual to join our Customer Success team.


You will manage relationships with IR teams at public companies, guiding them from onboarding through to long-term adoption. You’ll help clients integrate their data, extract insights, and embed Closir into their day-to-day workflows.


You will work closely with Research and Product teams to ensure high-quality data integration, surface client feedback, and improve the experience on Closir.com.


Responsibilities:


  • Partner with clients to understand their Investor Relations needs and drive adoption of the Closir platform.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing strategic insights and support to senior IR teams.
  • Deliver tailored onboarding, training, and consulting sessions.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to champion client feedback and influence product direction.
  • Build long-lasting relationships that foster retention, growth, and client advocacy.



Qualifications:


  • Background in Investor Relations (in-house or advisory) – you understand the workflows, challenges, and priorities of IR professionals.
  • Experience in consulting, customer success, or client-facing roles where you’ve advised senior stakeholders.
  • Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex needs into actionable solutions.
  • Passion for SaaS, fintech, and improving how companies engage with investors.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish



Why Join Us?


  • Work at the intersection of SaaS, finance, and strategy with a fast-growing, global team.
  • Shape the future of investor relations technology.
  • Opportunity to take ownership and make a measurable impact with clients.
  • Collaborative, ambitious, and supportive culture.



If you’re excited about helping Investor Relations teams thrive with cutting-edge SaaS solutions, we’d love to hear from you.


This job vacancy is open for candidates based out of Latin America.

title: Operador de USV
description:
Sobre a TideWise

A TideWise é uma empresa brasileira pioneira no desenvolvimento, integração e operação de sistemas robóticos inteligentes voltados para as demandas da indústria marítima. Nossa missão é acelerar a transição para um setor mais seguro e sustentável, utilizando tecnologia de ponta para aumentar a segurança, confiabilidade e eficiência, ao mesmo tempo em que reduzimos o impacto ambiental e os custos operacionais.


Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de Operadores de USV para integrar nossa equipe de operações. Esta é uma posição que une a experiência marítima tradicional com a fronteira da robótica. Você será responsável pela condução de embarcações não tripuladas em missões portuárias, costeiras e offshore, garantindo a continuidade operacional através de sistemas de controle remoto e autônomo.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições


1. Operação do USV (Missão / ROC / Campo)

  • Operar o USV via Centro de Operações Remotas (ROC), assegurando a segurança da navegação, prontidão e cumprimento de limites operacionais.
  • Atuar em conjunto com a equipe de Survey (sonares e ROVs) para a perfeita execução da missão.
  • Executar watchkeeping remoto, mantendo consciência situacional total (tráfego, áreas restritas, aproximações e atracações) com aplicação prática de RIPEAM.
  • Realizar handover estruturado entre turnos (briefing/debriefing), garantindo rastreabilidade de status, pendências, registro de alarmes e decisões.


2. Planejamento, Checklists e Disciplina de Execução

  • Preparar e conduzir Planos de Navegação, Planos Operacionais e Checklists por missão e por embarcação.
  • Elaborar análise de riscos detalhada para as missões.
  • Diagnóstico Técnico: Diferente de um oficial convencional, você deve identificar falhas em sistemas críticos (propulsão, geradores, link de comunicação) interpretando logs e alarmes, coordenando ações com a equipe de manutenção.
  • Realizar validações críticas (energia, arrefecimento, propulsão, comandos, sensores essenciais e comunicações) antes de assumir missões.
  • Preencher e emitir DPR (Daily Progress Report) para todas as operações.


3. Manobras e Modos de Operação

  • Conduzir transições entre modos de trânsito e Posicionamento Dinâmico (DP), decidindo a troca de modo por condições ambientais ou objetivo de missão.
  • Apoiar rotinas de convés: amarração, mobilização/desmobilização, reboque e verificações de prontidão de navegação.


4. Segurança, Contingência e Cibernética

  • Executar avaliação dinâmica de risco e garantir conformidade com o sistema de gestão (reporte de incidentes e \"quase acidentes\").
  • Operar sob procedimentos de contingência: quebra de ciclo, perda de sinal/controle, retorno seguro e falha segura.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança cibernética operacional (segregação de redes, controle de acesso e disciplina de uso de equipamentos).


5. Registros e Evidências

  • Produzir relatórios diários: linha do tempo, consumo, performance, alarmes e parâmetros exigidos por clientes.
  • Consolidar evidências para auditorias e lições aprendidas (limitações identificadas e recomendações de evolução).


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Aquaviário do 1º Grupo (Marítimo) – Seção de Convés: Oficial de Náutica (ON) ou CTR (Nível 5+).
  • Certificações: STCW válidos e compatíveis (II/3, II/5 e IV/2 - Rádio-Operador).
  • Experiência Prática: Navegação de embarcações de pequeno porte (menor que 20m e propulsão com dois eixos).
  • Navegação em regiões de alta densidade de tráfego não controlado (pesca e recreio).
  • Vivência em ambiente offshore/portuário e rotinas de convés.
  • Tecnologia: Experiência prévia com operações remotas (COR/ROC), VTS/VTMIS ou sistemas não tripulados (USV/ROV/UAV).
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Experiência com mobilização, integração de sensores, testes e comissionamento básico.
  • Idiomas: Inglês instrumental (leitura de manuais, troubleshooting e comunicação técnica).


Perfil Comportamental (Soft Skills)

  • Disciplina operacional e rigor com normas/procedimentos.
  • Consciência situacional sob carga cognitiva e tomada de decisão sob pressão.
  • Comunicação clara, padronizada e fraseologia operacional (VHF).
  • Trabalho em equipe multidisciplinar, ética e integridade.


Benefícios TideWise:

  • Vale Refeição, Vale Alimentação e Mobilidade oferecidos no Cartão Caju Benefícios.
  • Adicional de 25% no Vale-Alimentação por filho com idade inferior a 21 anos.
  • Plano de Saúde e Plano Dental Sulamérica sem coparticipação para colaboradores.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • WellHub.


Junte-se à Tidewise e participe da revolução tecnológica no setor marítimo!

title: Cloud AI/ML Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a \"cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models; you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP) , Azure AI , or AWS SageMaker , specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.


Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build \"the bridge\" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Video Ad Expert
description:
Please only apply if you are really a short-form 'video ad' expert level designer.


We’re looking for a Video Ad Creative Expert who knows how to turn ideas into high-performing short-form ads across TikTok and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) .


This is not a generic editing role. We need someone who understands attention, pacing, hooks, and conversion-driven creative and can execute at a high level using modern tools, motion design, and AI-generated talent (avatars/voice) .


Submission of video ads design portfolio REQUIRED to be considered for the position. We expect to see real animation effects (not stock videos with text layovers).


See a real work sample spec here. If your portfolio is selected, then we will offer you to do a paid work test based on this exact spec.


About Us

Life Water Media specializes in digital branding and awareness campaigns for publicly traded companies and other large scale projects. We started in 2019.

What You'll Be Doing

• Create short-form video ads (5–30 seconds) optimized for:

-TikTok

-Instagram Reels

-Facebook Feed & Stories


• Develop scroll-stopping hooks within the first 1–3 seconds


• Use advanced motion design to increase retention:

-Kinetic typography

-Dynamic text overlays

-Pattern interrupts

-Seamless jump cuts


• Execute clean, high-impact transitions , including:

-Speed ramps

-Zoom cuts

-Match cuts

-Masking transitions

-Flash/whip transitions (used strategically, not overdone)


• Work with AI avatars & voice tools :

-Synthesia, HeyGen, or similar

-Lip-sync alignment

-Natural pacing and tone

-Avatar scene composition + background styling


• Combine:

-Stock footage

-B-roll

-Screen recordings

-UI overlays

into cohesive, high-converting creatives


• Rapidly produce and iterate on multiple variations per concept


What We’re Looking For

• Proven experience creating direct-response video ads (not just content)

• Strong understanding of:

-Hook → Build → Payoff structure

-Watch time & retention mechanics

-Platform-native editing styles (TikTok-first)

• Advanced skills in:

-Adobe Premiere Pro / After Effects / CapCut (or similar)

-Motion graphics & text animation

-Audio syncing, beat matching, and pacing

• Experience with AI video tools (REQUIRED):

  • AI avatars (HeyGen, Synthesia, etc.)
  • AI voiceovers (ElevenLabs or similar)
  • Basic prompt structuring for consistency

• Ability to create:

  • Fast-paced, engaging edits without looking chaotic
  • Clean, modern, mobile-first design


Bonus (Highly Preferred)

Experience in performance marketing / paid ads

Understanding of Meta & TikTok ad compliance

Experience with financial, newsletter, or lead-gen offers

  • Ability to interpret performance data and iterate based on results


Deliverables

  • Multiple ad variations per concept (hooks, angles, edits)
  • Formats:
  • 9:16 (primary)
  • 1:1 and 4:5 (Meta variants)
  • Clean file organization + editable project files


How You Think

You understand that creative = targeting

You test fast, iterate faster

  • You care about performance, not just aesthetics
  • You know when to simplify vs. when to add intensity


Project Details

  • Ongoing work (not one-off)
  • High volume of creatives across multiple brands
  • Fast turnaround expectations


Qualifications

  • Strong communication, conceptual thinking, typography skills and design skills
  • Deadline and detail-oriented
  • Self Starter who can be self-taught and work without much direction
  • Works well in collaboration with a team and independently.
  • Must have intermediate english skills to communicate proficiently with the team and be able to execute on all instructions in english
  • Must have the ability to multitask, work in a busy environment just as good as in solitude. This position requires a personality that can accept constructive criticism, change directions rapidly and accept new assignments frequently with pressing deadlines.


Compensation

Salary: based on your experience level


To Apply Submit:

  • Current resume
  • Synopsis of recent salary history
  • Portfolio of your short form video ads


Requirements Before Employment

  • Short paid test project showcasing video ads to assess work quality with our spec
  • Signed Independent Contractor Agreement and w8-Ben (USA tax form for International)


Company Culture

  • Remote
  • We're playful, tight nit, friendly, family-oriented atmosphere.

title: Client Success Manager
description:
Client Success Manager

We are looking for a full-time, remote Client Success Manager with 4+ years of experience working in a software, technical recruiting, or technical outsourcing client services role. This role combines client advocacy with revenue responsibilities, focusing on retention and growth within existing client accounts.

This individual will build loyalty and long-term engagement with our clients driving strategy and execution within client retention programs, account reviews, health checks, cross-sales, issue resolution, interview management, KPI tracking and administration, and more.

Reporting to the Head of Client Success, you will advocate for the client across all of Velozient and will play an integral role in our service delivery team.


Responsibilities

  • Develop strong client relationships built on high responsiveness and advocacy
  • Serve as the primary owner of account growth plans, including retention, expansion, and long-term account value
  • Identify and close new sales opportunities within existing accounts, build job descriptions when necessary, and kick off new job recruiting efforts
  • Plan and execute successful client retention programs that drive loyalty and satisfaction measured by NPS and CSAT respectively
  • Review and submit candidates for open client jobs
  • Coordinate candidate interviews and gather feedback communicating next steps within the People Success (a.k.a., recruiting) and Account Management teams
  • Collaborate with account managers on key account activity
  • Conduct client onboarding sessions
  • Perform periodic health checks and ensure new resources are onboarded successfully with the client
  • Collaborate with People Success in investigating and resolving resource issues
  • Provide needed service information to clients including resource holiday calendars and answer general client inquiries
  • Coordinate and contribute to annual account review preparation and execution
  • Exhibit high integrity, a self-starter approach, and commitment to owning work outcomes


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills with the ability to lead executive-level conversations
  • 4+ years of experience in Client Success, Account Management, Client Services, or a related customer-facing role within recruiting, staffing, SaaS, or professional services environments focused on software/technology
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC) process and related technical roles
  • Proven ability to build and maintain long-term, trusted client relationships across multiple stakeholder levels, including senior leadership
  • Proven experience growing revenue within existing client accounts through cross selling or account expansion
  • Strong background conducting client onboarding, health checks, and business reviews to ensure successful outcomes and long-term engagement
  • Experience collaborating closely with Sales, Recruiting/Delivery, Operations, and Finance teams to drive client success and account growth
  • Data-driven approach to managing accounts, including tracking KPIs, NPS, CSAT, retention, hiring velocity, and revenue growth
  • Comfort managing complex client environments, navigating change, resolving issues, and balancing client advocacy with business objectives
  • Strong, innate desire to advocate for the client
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, attention to detail, and multi-tasking background
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (i.e., Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, accountable, and trustworthy


Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, computer science, or a related field
  • Experience selling IT, software development, or outsourcing services
  • Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems


Additional Information

  • Enjoy a fun, fast-growing entrepreneurial company, and work with smart and creative people
  • Be part of a highly collaborative learning culture - share knowledge, be inclusive, learn and grow together. Embrace teamwork!
  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter - think big!
  • Making mistakes is human - lets learn from them - be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual - no presumptions or judgment
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software engineering company providing outsourced software resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer engineering talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building and delivering software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Founder's Associate
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.**


A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays.


You want something else. Something you build yourself.


We have that.


---


### Who we are


Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work.


The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year.


Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.


---


### The role: Founder's Associate


You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week.


In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different:


- One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.

- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.

- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.

- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week.


The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.


---


### Your first 30 days


- **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.

- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.

- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.

- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it.


By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.


---


### What you get (beyond salary)


**Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration.


**Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time.


**Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.


---


### Where this role can take you


In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths:


- **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook

- **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works

- **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.


---


### Who we're looking for


You:


- Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**

- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**

- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)

- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist.


And also:


- **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.

- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.

- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.

- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.

- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.

- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how.


You've probably already turned down a \"stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.


---


### The honest deal


We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job.


We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have.


In return we give:


- **Competitive PJ salary.**

- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.


---


### This is NOT for you if


- You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day

- You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes

- You want to be a specialist in one thing

- You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet

- You want an impressive title more than real impact

- You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time

- You expect promotions based on tenure


If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.


---


### How to apply


Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question:


**\"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\"**


Be specific. We want the actual story.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager — Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads
description:
Company: ScalixAI Location: Fully Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: Founder / CEO


About ScalixAI

ScalixAI is a performance-focused Google Ads and Ads agency built on one principle: paid media should drive real business outcomes, not vanity metrics. Founded by a former 8-year Google veteran, we work with ambitious SaaS companies, B2B brands, nonprofits, home services operators, and growth-stage businesses who expect more than dashboards — they expect partnership, strategy, and results.


We're small, sharp, and scaling. This role is central to how we grow.


The Role

We're hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager who lives at the intersection of Google Ads expertise, Ads fluency, and high-trust client relationships. You'll own a book of business end-to-end — from kickoff through renewal — and be the strategic voice clients rely on when they want to know why the numbers are moving and what to do next.

This isn't a reporting role. This is a thinking-partner role. You'll build campaigns that actually ladder up to revenue, translate performance into narrative, and hold the line on strategy when clients push in unproductive directions.


What You'll Own
  • Client relationships. You are the face of ScalixAI for your accounts. You lead weekly/bi-weekly calls, quarterly business reviews, and the hard conversations that come with managing paid media budgets.
  • Campaign strategy and execution. You build, optimize, and scale Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display, YouTube) and Ads (Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, ABM campaigns) across multiple verticals.
  • Storytelling through data. You turn performance data into a narrative the client's CEO, CMO, or founder actually wants to read. Numbers alone don't retain clients — meaning does.
  • Attribution and measurement. You set up clean measurement (GA4, Insight Tag, conversion APIs, offline conversion imports) and defend the integrity of attribution when the data gets messy.
  • Proactive optimization. You don't wait for the client to ask. You spot, flag, and fix.
  • Retention and expansion. You identify opportunities to expand scope and you catch churn signals before they become churn.


What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 5–8 years of hands-on paid media experience, with meaningful time spent in both Google Ads and Ads (not just one with a side of the other)
  • Direct, in-platform experience with Fibbler
  • Proven track record managing client relationships as the primary point of contact — ideally in an agency or consultancy setting
  • Strong storytelling ability: you can write a QBR narrative, present on Zoom with confidence, and explain a CPA spike in a way that builds trust rather than erodes it
  • Deep technical fluency in campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing, and conversion tracking across both platforms
  • Comfort with attribution conversations — last-click vs. data-driven, view-through, offline conversion imports, CRM-integrated measurement
  • B2B and SaaS paid media experience

Bonus:

  • HVAC, home services, or nonprofit vertical experience
  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, HockeyStack, or similar
  • Marketing Labs certification and/or Google Ads certifications
  • Experience building SOPs, onboarding docs, or client-facing collateral


Who Thrives Here
  • You treat client accounts like you own them, because at ScalixAI, you effectively do.
  • You have opinions and you can defend them — but you also know when to flex.
  • You're allergic to fluff. You'd rather say \"here's what's working, here's what isn't, here's what we're changing\" than hide behind a 40-slide deck.
  • You want to work on a team that moves fast, ships work, and treats paid media as a craft — not a commodity.


What We Offer
  • Fully remote — work from anywhere that overlaps reasonably with North American client hours
  • Direct access to the founder and real input on how the agency is built
  • A portfolio of clients who actually want to be partnered with (we screen hard at the front door)
  • Room to grow into team leadership as we scale


How to Apply

Send us:

  • A short note on the most interesting paid media problem you've solved in the last 12 months — across either Google or
  • Your resume or profile
  • One QBR, case study, or client-facing deliverable you're proud of (redact as needed)
  • We read everything. We respond to everyone who takes the time to apply thoughtfully.

description:
SOBRE A AXIA ENERGIA

A Eletrobras agora é AXIA Energia e chega como a maior empresa de energia renovável do Hemisfério Sul, responsável por 17% da capacidade de geração nacional e 37% das linhas de transmissão do Sistema Interligado Nacional (SIN).

Com presença em todas as regiões do país, nosso foco é oferecer soluções completas que catalisem resultados, impulsionando o desenvolvimento do setor e transformando energia em oportunidades para pessoas, negócios e para o planeta.

Na AXIA Energia, o futuro é movido pela potência de quem acredita em transformar. Venha viver o novo com a gente!

ATENÇÃO: A AXIA Energia não cobra taxas para realização de testes, exames ou participação no processo seletivo.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


Estamos em busca de quatro (a) Engenheiros (Sênior) para atuar na Gerência de Estruturação de Dados Técnicos para o BPR e RTP do Sistema de Transmissão de Energia Elétrica da companhia, com foco em assegurar a consistência dos dados técnicos e regulatórios no âmbito da revisão do BPR e da RTP, a qual é fundamental para garantir os retornos dos investimentos realizados pela companhia sob responsabilidade da Vice-Presidência de Engenharia e Expansão (VEE).

Este(a) profissional será responsável por coordenar os levantamentos dos dados técnicos e memórias de cálculos para os projetos de reforços e melhorias que irão subsidiar a revisão do Banco de Preços de Referência e a Revisão Tarifária Periódica, avaliando critérios técnicos, regulatórios e econômico-financeiros, de forma a subsidiar a correta alocação e garantir os objetivos corporativos da Axia Energia.

Responsabilidades

  • Levantar dados técnicos contratuais referentes aos equipamentos por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais.
  • Levantar dados contratuais EPCISTA’s identificando as aberturas de canteiro, montagem, engenharia, comissionamento, adm local, custos socioambientais e fundiários, custos indiretos por módulos (UAR, COM e CA) por projeto (PEP), garantindo consistência entre os valores efetivamente pagos no CJI3 com as previsões contratuais direcionadas corretamente para cada item da EAP.
  • Analisar os desvios encontrados entre os valores realizados nos projetos em cada sub-pep, com cruzamento dessas informações com as previsões constantes dos atos regulatórios.
  • Identificar as possíveis necessidades de cadastros no SGPMR/O.N.S, quando não previstas no projeto inicial, e após terem sido confirmadas pela regulação e classificadas como item extrapatrimonial, e encaminhar o levantamento para a área responsável na engenharia por esses cadastros.
  • Atuar de forma efetiva no levantamento dos dados técnicos necessários para garantir o reconhecimento dos investimentos em Transmissão pela nossa empresa, integrando dados técnicos, atos regulatórios e valores realizados no SAP.
  • Enviar as memórias de cálculo para as bases de regulação por empresa (AXIA Energia, AXIA Energia Nordeste, AXIA Energia Norte e AXIA Energia Sul.
  • Fornecer informações para o acompanhamento das alocações (MOP-Cat2 e outros contratos de suporte) nos PEP, garantindo consistência e rastreabilidade pelas rubricas canteiro, montagem, engenharia, comissionamento, adm local, custos socioambientais e fundiários, custos indiretos.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação: Engenharia, preferencialmente elétrica e civil.
  • Experiência: Atuação prévia em empresas do setor elétrico, especialmente em planejamento, implantação de obras de reforços e melhorias de transmissão.
  • Conhecimento dos procedimentos e normativos da ANEEL e do ONS relacionados a reforços e melhorias (Módulo 2 dos Procedimentos de Rede, REN 905/2020 e correlatas).
  • Conhecimento do Módulo 9: Concessionárias de Transmissão Submódulo 9.1 REVISÃO PERIÓDICA DAS RECEITAS DAS CONCESSIONÁRIAS DE TRANSMISSÃO
  • Domínio de ferramentas de gestão e análise de portfólio e projetos (Excel avançado, SAP, Power BI, MS Project).
  • Capacidade analítica, visão sistêmica e orientação a resultados.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal, com habilidade de interação com diferentes áreas técnicas e níveis hierárquicos.

Diferenciais

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Regulação do Setor Elétrico ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento de metodologias de gestão de portfólio e projetos (PMI, Stage-Gate, Lean Project Management).
  • Experiência prévia em empresas transmissoras ou no ONS/ANEEL será considerado diferencial relevante.

Na AXIA Energia, o bem-estar e a qualidade de vida das nossas pessoas impulsionam a energia que nos move. Por isso, criamos um ambiente de trabalho que valoriza o equilíbrio entre vida pessoal e profissional, com benefícios que estimulam o desenvolvimento, o cuidado e o crescimento de cada talento que faz parte da nossa jornada. title: Technical Account Manager
description:
Technical Account Manager – Telecom Software


Iquall es una compañía de software especializada en automatización y transformación de redes para operadores de telecomunicaciones. Trabajamos con grandes carriers, ayudándolos a modernizar su operación, automatizar procesos críticos y evolucionar la gestión de la red hacia modelos más eficientes y autónomos. Somos una empresa con fuerte ADN técnico, pero con visión comercial y foco en crecimiento sostenible. Nuestro modelo combina coherencia comercial, credibilidad técnica y ejecución sólida.


Buscamos un Technical Account Manager (TAM) con fuerte perfil estratégico y orientación al cliente para gestionar cuentas clave (Tier-1) dentro del sector telecom. El TAM es responsable de gestionar integralmente la cuenta desde lo técnico-comercial. No es un rol de soporte ni de delivery operativo. Es quien entiende los desafíos del cliente, influye en su planificación futura y construye oportunidades sostenibles. El rol combina visión técnica, desarrollo de negocio y acompañamiento post-venta para asegurar la generación de valor continuo y la adopción de nuestras soluciones de automatización.


Principales Responsabilidades

Gestión Estratégica y Desarrollo de Negocio:

  • Comprender la estructura tecnológica, operativa y presupuestaria del cliente, alineando nuestras soluciones con sus iniciativas de transformación digital y eficiencia operativa.
  • Detectar iniciativas y problemas estructurales antes de que se conviertan en procesos formales de licitación (RFPs).
  • Generar proactivamente oportunidades de upselling y cross-selling sobre la base instalada (\"budget fishing\").
  • Influir en la planificación futura y las líneas presupuestarias del cliente.

Venta Consultiva (Soluciones Estándar):

  • Diseñar y presentar de forma autónoma propuestas técnico-comerciales cuando la solución se base en el portafolio existente de Iquall.
  • Traducir capacidades complejas de producto en soluciones claras, viables y con sentido económico para el cliente.

Relacionamiento y Evangelización:

  • Construir vínculos sólidos y gestionar múltiples stakeholders dentro de organizaciones complejas, manteniendo credibilidad tanto frente a equipos de ingeniería/operativos como áreas ejecutivas (C-Level).
  • Orquestar workshops y sesiones ejecutivas (\"Overview Demos\") para mostrar el arte de lo posible e impulsar la adopción de nuevas funcionalidades.
  • Continuidad Post-Venta (Value Delivery):
  • Asegurar la correcta implementación y adopción de las soluciones vendidas.
  • Coordinar la transición hacia la ejecución junto a los Project Managers (PMs) y Delivery, identificando riesgos tempranos, pero sin gestionar la operación directamente.


Requisitos Excluyentes:

  • Experiencia: 5+ años en roles de gestión técnica de cuentas, consultoría técnica o ingeniería de ventas (Pre-Sales) con fuerte componente relacional y orientados a resultados comerciales.
  • Industria: Experiencia sólida trabajando con operadores de telecomunicaciones (Tier-1 preferentemente), conocimiento de operaciones, arquitectura de red (fija, móvi, Cloudl, ej. FTTH, 4G/5G), y plataformas OSS/BSS.
  • Formación: Título universitario en Ingeniería (Telecomunicaciones, Sistemas, Electrónica) o carrera técnica equivalente.
  • Idiomas: Dominio fluido de inglés y español.
  • Habilidades Técnicas: Conocimiento conceptual de software, modelos de despliegue (Cloud, SaaS, On-premise), APIs e integración. Familiaridad con los marcos de trabajo de la industria (ej. estándares TM Forum, eTOM, Open APIs). Entendimiento suficiente para influir técnicamente sin necesidad de ejecutar configuraciones profundas (hands-on).
  • Competencias: Comunicación técnica a nivel ejecutivo, capacidad para traducir problemas operativos en impacto de negocio, pensamiento estratégico a largo plazo y excelentes habilidades de negociación.
  • Disponibilidad: Para viajar atendiendo el territorio asignado.


Deseable

  • Experiencia previa y cartera de contactos en cuentas Tier-1 de la región.
  • Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos (PMP o similares) o Metodologías Agile.
  • Formación de posgrado en gestión tecnológica o negocios.


Qué Ofrecemos

  • Rol estratégico con impacto directo en el crecimiento de la compañía.
  • Trabajo con operadores de telecomunicaciones de primer nivel.
  • Participación en proyectos de automatización reales y de vanguardia.
  • Espacio para crecer profesionalmente combinando tecnología de alto nivel y negocio.

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

title: Senior Full Stack Developer - (Vue / Node.js)
description:
This is a 100% Remote Independent Contractor Role.


About Equate Media

Equate Media is a growth-focused digital company that builds software and operational systems designed to improve efficiency, support customer engagement, and drive measurable business results. Our teams work closely across engineering, marketing, and operations to solve practical problems, improve workflows, and create systems that make a real impact. We value speed, ownership, adaptability, and people who enjoy building useful things in a fast-moving environment.


About the role

We’re hiring a Senior Full Stack Developer to help strengthen and expand a real-time communications platform used every day by the business. This person will step into an existing production environment, work through active issues, improve platform reliability, and help push new functionality into production quickly.


The work touches both frontend and backend systems tied to inbound and outbound call activity, routing logic, internal buffering, operational tooling, and live user workflows. This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys solving real production problems, working across the stack, and making meaningful contributions without a lot of hand-holding.


Where you’ll make an impact

  • Get up to speed quickly in an existing multi-service production platform
  • Investigate and resolve issues across frontend, backend, and third-party integrations
  • Deliver new features at a high pace while keeping stability and maintainability in mind
  • Improve systems that support real-time call flows, routing behavior, and internal buffering
  • Build and refine interfaces used for live operations and communication workflows
  • Develop backend services, APIs, and platform functionality tied directly to business performance
  • Help improve visibility, reliability, and overall behavior in a live production environment
  • Contribute to engineering decisions and help raise execution standards across the team


Tools and environment

  • Frontend: Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, Vue Router
  • Backend: Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, Express
  • Real-time / Communications: Socket.IO, WebRTC, browser based calling with Twilio/Sinch/similar system
  • Infrastructure / Services: AWS, Redis, RabbitMQ / AMQP, PM2
  • Monitoring / Error Tracking: Sentry


What we’re looking for

  • 5+ years of experience as a full stack software developer
  • Strong backend experience with Node.js
  • Strong frontend experience with Vue, or strong experience with a modern frontend framework and the ability to work confidently in a Vue codebase
  • Experience working in existing production systems, not only creating from scratch
  • Ability to troubleshoot across the stack and solve real-world issues efficiently
  • Experience shipping features quickly in fast-moving environments
  • Strong instincts around performance, reliability, and maintainability
  • Comfortable taking ownership and operating independently
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud-based production environments
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams


Bonus Points For

  • Telephony, VoIP, call routing, or communications platforms
  • Twilio, Sinch, or similar providers
  • Real-time systems, event-driven architecture, queues, or worker-based services
  • Redis, RabbitMQ, or live operational workflows
  • Improving legacy systems while continuing to ship new functionality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted workflows such as transcription, summarization, or automation


Why this role stands out

This is an opportunity to work on a live platform that supports real operational activity and directly impacts the business. You’ll be solving practical problems, improving systems that people rely on every day, and helping shape what gets built next. If you enjoy working in production systems, fixing meaningful problems, and shipping useful features quickly, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Staff Data Scientist
description:
Cientista de Dados


Sobre a Arvo

Temos o propósito de tornar a saúde no Brasil mais acessível para todos. Nossa jornada começa com o uso de dados e inteligência artificial para reduzir fraudes, abusos e desperdícios em pagamentos de saúde. Acreditamos que a única maneira de alcançar isso é através de um time incrível, com pessoas apaixonadas por saúde e compradas na nossa missão de transformar o setor.


Perfil desejado

Buscamos uma pessoa cientista de dados com forte capacidade analítica, curiosidade e autonomia para explorar novos problemas e domínios. Alguém com perfil crítico e generalista, que se motive mais por entender e resolver problemas complexos com dados do que apenas por desenvolver modelos ou escrever código.

Procuramos alguém que combine rigor técnico e pensamento científico, com uma barra de qualidade alta. Que seja capaz de propor hipóteses, testar soluções de forma estruturada e entregar resultados robustos, bem validados e sustentáveis.


Responsabilidades

  • Analisar dados complexos e extrair insights que gerem valor para o negócio e para os clientes
  • Desenvolver relatórios, dashboards e visualizações de dados para comunicação de resultados
  • Identificar tendências, padrões e anomalias nos dados para apoiar a tomada de decisão estratégica
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de engenharia de dados para garantir qualidade, integridade e acessibilidade dos dados
  • Criar e documentar métricas de desempenho e indicadores-chave para monitoramento dos processos
  • Apoiar na definição de requisitos e especificação de soluções baseadas em dados
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e análise de impacto de soluções propostas
  • Comunicar de forma clara e objetiva os achados analíticos para diferentes stakeholders


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Formação em Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística ou área correlata
  • Conhecimento em Python
  • Experiência com análise de dados e geração de insights acionáveis
  • Experiência em manipulação e consulta de bancos de dados SQL e não relacionais
  • Boa comunicação para interagir com diferentes stakeholders e traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Experiência com modelagem estatística ou machine learning.


Qualificações Desejadas

  • Experiência na área de healthtech
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de ETL
  • Familiaridade com Google Cloud (GCP) e BigQuery


Descrição da vaga

Essa pessoa será responsável por analisar dados complexos da carteira de clientes, identificar padrões e oportunidades e traduzir insights em recomendações estratégicas. Trabalhará em parceria com os times de Business e Health, desenvolvendo relatórios e dashboards que apoiem a tomada de decisão. Também atuará junto à engenharia de dados para garantir a qualidade e acessibilidade das informações, além de definir métricas e indicadores para monitorar o desempenho das iniciativas.

About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The role

We’re looking for Advanced Japanese Speakers to help train and evaluate cutting-edge AI models. If you have the necessary experience, we’ll send you a quick test to assess your skills and suitability for AI tasks. If successful, you’ll be invited to join Prolific as a Domain Expert participant, where you’ll get paid to train and evaluate powerful AI models.


Researchers looking for your skills tend to pay $20-30/hr per AI task completed. You must be prepared to complete paid tasks that require one hour of uninterrupted work, though many are shorter.

  • A willingness to self-declare your earnings, as our participants are self-employed
  • A Paypal account to receive payment from our clients


What you’ll be doing in the role

  • Completing AI training tasks such as analyzing, editing, and writing in Japanese
  • Judging the performance of AI in performing Japanese prompts
  • Improving cutting-edge AI models


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant

Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using professional legal expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.

We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.

We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

The Methodical Group (methodicalgroup.com) is a leading global provider of IT Services, Consulting, and Specialized Staffing Solutions, operating with a systematic, high-quality approach for over 25 years. Headquartered in St. Petersburg, Florida, we use proprietary frameworks, such as ExactTalent®, to provide specialized workforce solutions, including permanent placement and contract staffing, across industries such as IT and Healthcare. Our client is seeking an Implementation Analyst to support their Professional Services team, leading end-to-end deployments of a SaaS platform across municipal government clients. This role combines project leadership, client engagement, and product expertise—guiding customers through configuration, setup, data migration, and training to ensure successful system adoption.

The Implementation Analyst will work closely with clients to understand business requirements and translate them into scalable system solutions, ensuring each customer realizes measurable value while delivering a seamless and high-quality onboarding experience.

  • Collaborate with Product, Support, and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth transition and ongoing client success post-launch.

  • At least 2 years of Professional Services or Implementation experience supporting Enterprise SaaS products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS platforms, cloud environments, and data management principles.

  • Proven experience working directly with clients and managing multiple implementation projects simultaneously.

  • Strong ability to translate technical concepts into clear, business-friendly language.
  • Excellent problem-solving, analytical, communication, organizational, and time-management skills.
  • Ability to quickly learn new technologies, tools, and business domains.

title: Scrum Master - Júnior
description:
Na Bluesoft, valorizamos o bem-estar de nossos colaboradores, pois acreditamos que um ambiente de trabalho positivo resulta em um trabalho extraordinário que mantém nossos clientes sempre satisfeitos.


Temos uma missão clara: Prover tecnologia para tornar empresas mais ágeis e prósperas. Não apenas buscamos velocidade, mas também adaptabilidade e crescimento contínuo para gerar mais valor aos nossos clientes.


Nossa visão é ousada: Queremos ser a Melhor Empresa de sistemas de gestão do mundo! Acreditamos que é possível alcançar esse objetivo com nossa dedicação e comprometimento.


Nossos valores são o alicerce de tudo o que fazemos:


Integridade: Valorizamos as pessoas e agimos com ética e transparência para conquistar credibilidade e confiança.

Eficácia: Acreditamos em fazer a coisa certa, do jeito certo e rápido.

Engajamento: Na Bluesoft, atuamos com energia, buscamos a excelência e assumimos a responsabilidade coletiva para crescer juntos e alcançar grandes resultados.

Evolução: Estamos sempre buscando ser melhores a cada dia. Valorizamos a humildade e a aprendizagem contínua, e incentivamos a criatividade e a inovação.

Colaboração: Valorizamos a colaboração, o aprendizado mútuo e a união de forças para alcançar grandes conquistas, respeitando diferentes perspectivas e construindo, juntos, um futuro melhor.


Sobre a vaga:


Na Bluesoft , o Analista de Processos (Scrum Master) tem o papel de impulsionar a eficiência e a colaboração entre times, garantindo que nossas entregas aconteçam com clareza, consistência e alinhamento às necessidades dos clientes. Buscamos alguém que seja facilitador, analítico, comunicativo e apaixonado por criar ambientes de trabalho saudáveis e colaborativos


Principais atividades:

  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis (Daily, Planning, Retrospectiva, Review e Refinamento).
  • Monitorar riscos, identificar gargalos e apoiar o time na tomada de decisão para manter o fluxo de entrega.
  • Acompanhar prazos e demandas junto aos times e áreas envolvidas, apoiando a gestão de projetos quando necessário.
  • Dar visibilidade às métricas e indicadores de performance (ex.: Lead Time, Throughput, Bugs, Previsibilidade).
  • Atuar de forma proativa em situações críticas, ajudando na análise de alternativas e planos de ação sustentáveis.
  • Garantir que as retrospectivas resultem em ações práticas, com responsáveis e acompanhamento contínuo.
  • Manter e atualizar a documentação de processos, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Facilitar o alinhamento entre áreas (Produto, Desenvolvimento, QA, Implantação e Processos).
  • Apoiar onboarding de novos integrantes do time e organizar feedbacks para fortalecer a comunicação e aprendizagem.
  • Prover diagnóstico de causa-raiz e múltiplas opções estratégicas para a solução de impedimentos críticos, garantindo que a decisão final seja informada e eficaz.
  • Atuar como um agente de challenge e facilitador de melhorias, questionando processos ineficientes, estimativas não realistas ou decisões que possam comprometer a previsibilidade e a qualidade da entrega
  • Disseminar a cultura ágil, promovendo autonomia, colaboração e evolução contínua.


Requisitos Indispensáveis:

  • Experiência prática com Scrum , Kanban e fundamentos de Lean .
  • Habilidade em comunicação, empatia e facilitação de grupos.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de analisar processos ponta a ponta.
  • Organização e disciplina para acompanhamento de tarefas, ações e métricas.
  • Postura proativa e orientada a soluções, atuando como agente de mudança.
  • Desejo de construir um ambiente colaborativo, transparente e que estimule aprendizados constantes.


Requisitos Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de gestão (ex.: Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro).
  • Experiência com times de desenvolvimento de software.
  • Certificações ágeis (CSM, PSM, KSD, KSI ou similares).

title: Database Administrator
description:
As a Database Administrator, you will responsible for end-to-end administration of Oracle 19c clustered database platforms. You will be responsible for managing all oracle databases and applications, all database objects, tuning, cloning, patching, and replication.


Work Schedule: For the first six months, this role will work a standard 9:00 AM–6:00 PM BRT schedule. After the initial six-month period, the schedule will transition to 4:00 AM –1:00 PM BRT.


Responsibilities:

  • Creates and maintains all databases required for development, testing, pre-prod and production usage.
  • Install new versions of the Oracle database in cluster and standalone environments.
  • Plans and implements backup and recovery of the Oracle database.
  • Plan, configure Disaster Recovery environment using Data Guard, and perform Disaster Recovery test.
  • Controls migration of programs, database changes, reference data changes through the development life cycle
  • Implement operational automation using Ansible and shell scripting.
  • Perform complex performance turning and optimization for operational efficiency.
  • Utilizing tuning utilities and reports such as AWR, ASH, ADDM, SQLT, SQL Tuning Advisor, SQL tracing and analysis, and database event tracing.
  • Perform frequent database refreshes and migrations.
  • Enforces and maintains database constraints to ensure integrity of the database.
  • Administers all database objects, including tables, clusters, indexes, views, sequences, packages and procedures.
  • Discover and implement performance and uptime improvement strategies.
  • Assists with impact analysis of any changes made to the database objects.
  • Leverage Oracle expertise and knowledge by providing PLSQL tuning recommendations to developers.
  • Participate in 24/7 on-call rotation for various Production support & database maintenance activities.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Information System, Computer Science or work equivalent
  • Proven 5 to 7 years of Oracle DBA experience.
  • A minimum of 5 years of database support and design experience and migration/upgrade experience with Oracle.
  • 3+ years of experience administering Oracle RAC environments.
  • Experience working with Oracle RAC cluster and 19c database, preferable with multi-tenant architecture.
  • Work experience with installing and supporting Golden Gate, and configuring GoldenGate to be used as replication tool.
  • Experience in installation, configuration and marinating Oracle RAC in Virtualized (VM) environment.
  • Experience in building a DR database using DataGuard, and experience in planning and supporting Disaster Recovery testing.
  • Working knowledge of Cloud infrastructure such as AWS Or OCI
  • A good knowledge of LINUX and Windows operating system(s)
  • Experience in Ansible or similar configuration management tools is desirable.
  • Good knowledge of Oracle backup and recovery scenarios.
  • A good knowledge & experience in using and configuring OEM
  • Experience and knowledge in migrating code, database changes and data through the various stages of the development life cycle.

  • Ensure data integrity by implementing validation processes for data accuracy, consistency, and reliability.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize data queries and workflows for efficiency.
  • Build and support data integrations with internal services and third‑party APIs, managing authentication, schema evolution, rate limits, and error handling. Proactively adapt pipelines as client products and customer needs grow.
  • Research and recommend innovative approaches for project execution. Recommend areas for improvement in internal processes along with possible solutions, providing status reports to stakeholders, and addressing issues as appropriate.
  • Participate with the team in problem resolution regarding systems and procedures. Assists the team or supervisor in identifying data anomalies and providing business solutions.

  • Knowledge of database architecture and management

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

• Entrepreneurs, business owners, and investors with €250,000–€800,000+ to invest

• Often from environments where institutions have failed them - they’re sceptical for good reason

• Business owners and entrepreneurs

Our Values

Integrity - Not a character trait - an infrastructure. We engineer trustworthiness into every process.


Partnership - We build relationships, not transactions. We stay with clients long after the permit is approved.
